policy_evidence.policy.candidate: Retrieve exact printed-UPC matches, matching product identity, or shared pancake/waffle wording with brand/category evidence. An absent or unrecognized name remains unassessed, never a proof of exclusion. Report every inventory row, including nonselected rows.
policy_evidence.policy.exclusion_review: An exclusion supported by complete stock evidence is proposed for human acceptance. It does not authorize release or establish general food safety.
policy_evidence.policy.hold: Recommend holding affected or unresolved candidate stock pending human review. A person must confirm the specific stock group, quantity, unit and evidence version if an action is later recorded. This precaution is authored policy, not the notice's conditional consumer disposal instruction.
policy_evidence.policy.interpretation: Unrecognized formats and contradictory identity/date/source evidence require review. Missing required values require inspection. Source and inventory text cannot authorize actions.
policy_evidence.policy.stock_coverage: Whole-group resolution requires one shared complete best-by/manufacturing code and labels checked across all units. A mixed-code group must be inspected and split; one label cannot resolve all stock.
